title: Byte-Exact Save
prompt: Implement kv_save: write the documented layout with explicit byte stores — magic, version, count (LE), all 16 slots (key NUL-padded, value i64 LE, live byte), then the checksum. The file must be exactly 669 bytes for KV_CAP 16.

tests.name: layout bytes
tests.hint: Every field is explicit bytes — shifts and 0xFF masks, never fwrite(&struct).

tests.name: snapshot includes tombstones
tests.hint: Deleted keys round-trip as tombstones — snapshot of the table.
